sources.title: Semgrep rule syntax and rule semantics

criteria.title: Public metadata applied at controller scope
criteria.detection_intent: Detect controller-wide public metadata that may unintentionally expose protected operations.
limitations: Pattern matching cannot establish the effective guard chain or intended public surface.

criteria.title: Client-controlled role enters authority data
criteria.detection_intent: Detect authority claims populated directly from request DTO or body role fields.
limitations: Aliases and inter-file flows may not be detected by the Community engine.

criteria.title: Client-controlled subject enters ownership scope
criteria.detection_intent: Detect token subject or ownership scope selected from request-controlled identifiers.
limitations: A match requires researcher review of trust boundaries and data flow.

criteria.title: Untrusted DTO assigned wholesale to an entity
criteria.detection_intent: Detect broad object assignment that may copy authorization or ownership fields.
limitations: The rule cannot determine the actual DTO allowlist or entity field sensitivity.

criteria.title: Request-controlled outbound target
criteria.detection_intent: Detect request fields used directly as outbound URL, host or callback targets.
limitations: Sanitizers, allowlists and indirect flows require manual review.

criteria.title: JWT signing without explicit expiry
criteria.detection_intent: Detect JWT signing calls that appear to omit explicit bounded expiration configuration.
limitations: Module-level defaults and wrapper functions may create false positives or negatives.

criteria.title: Cross-site authentication cookie configuration
criteria.detection_intent: Detect SameSite=None cookie configuration requiring contextual CSRF review.
limitations: SameSite=None is not independently a vulnerability and always requires contextual triage.

criteria.title: Security secret has a fallback value
criteria.detection_intent: Detect security-sensitive environment variables with embedded fallback values.
limitations: Generic matching may miss configuration wrappers or flag non-secret examples.

criteria.title: Internal exception detail returned to clients
criteria.detection_intent: Detect response fields populated from exception messages or stacks.
limitations: Logging-only uses and safe transformed errors require manual triage.

criteria.title: Wildcard CORS origin
criteria.detection_intent: Detect wildcard CORS origin configuration.
limitations: Risk depends on credentials, exposed data and endpoint authentication.

criteria.title: TypeORM schema synchronization enabled
criteria.detection_intent: Detect runtime schema synchronization enabled in source or configuration.
limitations: Environment-conditional configuration may require manual evaluation.

criteria.title: Hard-coded JWT or database secret
criteria.detection_intent: Detect embedded values assigned to common JWT or database secret names.
limitations: Name-based matching is bounded and must not persist the matched secret value.

criteria.title: Sensitive cookie security attribute disabled
criteria.detection_intent: Detect HttpOnly or Secure explicitly disabled on cookie configuration.
limitations: The rule does not establish whether the cookie carries sensitive data.

criteria.title: Privileged container or database port exposure
criteria.detection_intent: Detect privileged container mode or host publication of the database port.
limitations: Deployment boundary and network controls require contextual review.

criteria.title: Docker socket mounted into a container
criteria.detection_intent: Detect Docker daemon socket mounts that can confer host-level control.
limitations: Alternative container runtimes and indirect volume definitions may not match.

criteria.title: API documentation exposed without an environment gate
criteria.detection_intent: Detect unconditional Swagger document setup in application bootstrap code.
limitations: Surrounding environment gates may not be visible to a generic pattern.

criteria.title: Global validation pipe lacks strict allowlisting
criteria.detection_intent: Detect global ValidationPipe construction with explicitly disabled whitelist or forbidNonWhitelisted controls.
limitations: Defaults and wrapper factories require manual review.

criteria.title: Production source maps explicitly enabled
criteria.detection_intent: Detect source-map generation explicitly enabled in production-oriented configuration.
limitations: Build-mode selection and artifact publication require runtime/deployment evidence.

criteria.title: Directory browsing
criteria.detection_intent: Detect web-accessible directory listings.
limitations: Only discovered and scanned paths are observable.

criteria.title: Private IP disclosure
criteria.detection_intent: Detect private network addresses disclosed in HTTP response content.
limitations: Only observed responses are evaluated and benign examples may require triage.

criteria.title: Session identifier exposed through URL or referrer
criteria.detection_intent: Detect session identifiers placed in URLs or exposed through Referer headers.
limitations: Requires an observed session-bearing response or request.

criteria.title: Path traversal
criteria.detection_intent: Probe reachable inputs for file-system path traversal behavior.
limitations: Active coverage is bounded to discovered parameters and enabled attack strength.

criteria.title: Debug error message disclosure
criteria.detection_intent: Detect debug-oriented error details in observed responses.
limitations: Only exercised error paths are observable.

criteria.title: Sensitive information in URL
criteria.detection_intent: Detect potentially sensitive values transported in URL components.
limitations: Sensitivity and exploitability require researcher triage.

criteria.title: SameSite cookie weakness
criteria.detection_intent: Detect missing, invalid or None SameSite attributes on observed cookies.
limitations: Cookie sensitivity and intended cross-site behavior require contextual triage.

criteria.title: Username hash or IDOR indicator
criteria.detection_intent: Detect response indicators that may warrant manual IDOR analysis.
limitations: The indicator does not confirm exploitable IDOR and requires manual verification.

criteria.title: Cross-domain misconfiguration
criteria.detection_intent: Detect observed cross-domain policy that permits overly broad reads.
limitations: Authenticated CORS behavior and browser credential semantics may require active contextual checks.

criteria.title: Anti-CSRF token absent
criteria.detection_intent: Detect forms or requests lacking recognizable anti-CSRF tokens.
limitations: Bearer-only APIs and SameSite protections can make the rule not applicable.

criteria.title: Session management weakness
criteria.detection_intent: Probe observed session mechanisms for transport, script access, expiry and fixation weaknesses.
limitations: Requires an authenticated session mechanism and beta add-on availability.

criteria.title: HTTP 403 bypass
criteria.detection_intent: Probe forbidden resources for common access-control bypass variations.
limitations: Only discovered 403 resources are evaluated and the rule is beta.

criteria.title: In-page banner information leak
criteria.detection_intent: Detect product or framework banner information in response content.
limitations: Only observed responses are evaluated.

criteria.title: Cookie missing HttpOnly
criteria.detection_intent: Detect observed cookies without the HttpOnly attribute.
limitations: The tool cannot determine whether every observed cookie is sensitive.

criteria.title: Cookie missing Secure
criteria.detection_intent: Detect observed cookies without the Secure attribute.
limitations: Plain HTTP research environments can make this observation expected but still visible.

criteria.title: Content-Type header missing or empty
criteria.detection_intent: Detect missing or empty Content-Type response headers.
limitations: Some status codes or empty responses may not require a content type.

criteria.title: Anti-clickjacking header weakness
criteria.detection_intent: Detect absent, duplicate or malformed anti-clickjacking response controls.
limitations: CSP frame-ancestors and endpoint framing requirements require contextual review.

criteria.title: X-Content-Type-Options missing
criteria.detection_intent: Detect responses without X-Content-Type-Options nosniff.
limitations: Only observed response types are evaluated.

criteria.title: Directory browsing indication
criteria.detection_intent: Detect response patterns indicating directory listing is enabled.
limitations: Only reached directory paths are observable.

criteria.title: Strict-Transport-Security weakness
criteria.detection_intent: Detect missing, disabled or malformed HSTS configuration.
limitations: HSTS is meaningful on HTTPS; HTTP-only local runtime coverage may be not evaluable.

criteria.title: Server header information disclosure
criteria.detection_intent: Detect server software or version disclosure in response headers.
limitations: A banner alone does not establish exploitability.

criteria.title: Content Security Policy weakness
criteria.detection_intent: Detect absent or non-enforcing Content-Security-Policy headers.
limitations: Header presence does not prove the policy is complete or effective.

criteria.title: Backend server header disclosure
criteria.detection_intent: Detect backend server identity exposed through response headers.
limitations: Only observed proxy/backend response paths are evaluated.

criteria.title: HTTPS page includes mixed content
criteria.detection_intent: Detect secure pages referencing content over insecure transport.
limitations: Requires HTTPS pages and observed rendered references.

criteria.title: Content Security Policy directive weakness
criteria.detection_intent: Detect obsolete, wildcard, unsafe or malformed CSP directives.
limitations: Application-specific script/style requirements require contextual triage.

criteria.title: Backup file disclosure
criteria.detection_intent: Probe discovered resources for accessible backup-file variants.
limitations: Coverage is bounded to discovered names and the rule is beta.

criteria.title: Environment file disclosure
criteria.detection_intent: Probe for web-accessible environment files.
limitations: The runner must redact any detected secret values from persisted output.

criteria.title: Hidden file exposure
criteria.detection_intent: Probe for accessible hidden files that may disclose configuration or source information.
limitations: Coverage is bounded to scanner wordlists and discovered paths.

criteria.title: Spring Actuator information leak
criteria.detection_intent: Probe for exposed Spring Actuator endpoints.
limitations: Not applicable when the target stack does not use Spring.
